_**Agent (copilot/claude-haiku-5.5)**_

Yes. The project uses Tailwind 4.1.12, which supports container queries natively. `sm:` reacts to the viewport, so I switched to `@sm:`, which reacts to the width of the nearest `@container` ancestor.

A container query can't style the element that is itself the container, so the grid moved into an inner `div`:

- Host: `@container mt-5`
- Template: `<div class="grid @sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4"><ng-content /></div>`

I also updated the commented CSS block at the bottom of `src/app/shared/ui/info-grid/info-grid.ts#L24-L31` to match. The `.vscode` snippet it refers to (`shared-components.code-snippets`) may need the same update, which I did not check or change.

The grid does collapse correctly. The editor column just never gets narrower than about 591px, which is above the `@lg` threshold of 512px, so it stays at 3 columns.

What I measured on `/deals` at `http://localhost:4200`:

- **Container width:** 591px at viewport 700 and 900. It only shrinks when the form's min-content is reduced.
- **Cause:** the debug `<pre>{{ form.value | json }}</pre>` in `src/app/features/deals/ui/deal-editor/deal-editor.ts` has a long unbreakable line (the  value). Its min-content width (about 631px) sets the editor column's minimum, so the `2fr` track can't shrink. The outer deals grid then overflows (851px in a 640px container).
- **Confirmed:** setting the `<pre>` to `white-space: pre-wrap` in the browser dropped the info grid to 373px, and it rendered as one column.

Possible fixes (I haven't changed anything yet):

1. Add `whitespace-pre-wrap break-all` to the `<pre>`, or remove it if it's only debugging output.
2. Add `min-w-0` to the editor's wrapper so it can shrink below its content width.
